text: Does your breathlessness suddenly wake you up from sleep?
Does lying flat make your breathlessness worse?
Do you feel breathless when walking on flat ground?
Are your ankles or legs swelling more than usual?
Have you gained sudden weight in the past few days?
Do you feel overly tired doing your basic daily activities?
Is one of your legs suddenly painful, red, swollen, or warm?
Do you have chest discomfort or pressure, especially with exertion?
Do your heartbeats feel irregular, very fast, or fluttering?
Have you almost fainted or completely fainted during this episode?
